description: This file manages the Redux state slice for views in a web application, including actions, selectors, and update logic for BoardView objects.

classes.name: ViewsState
classes.description: Type defining the shape of the views state, including current view ID and a dictionary of BoardView objects.

methods.name: smartViewUpdate
methods.description: Optimizes updating a BoardView by only changing fields that differ, avoiding unnecessary regeneration.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Returns a selector function to retrieve a specific BoardView by ID from the state.
